    1. customize(T)

Interface WebServerFactoryCustomizer<T extends WebServerFactory>

Type Parameters:
T - 可配置的 Web 服务器工厂
All Known Implementing Classes:
AccessLogCustomizer, JettyVirtualThreadsWebServerFactoryCustomizer, JettyWebServerFactoryCustomizer, ManagementWebServerFactoryCustomizer, NettyReactiveWebServerFactoryCustomizer, ReactiveWebServerFactoryCustomizer, ServletWebServerFactoryCustomizer, TomcatVirtualThreadsWebServerFactoryCustomizer, TomcatWebServerFactoryCustomizer, WebSocketJettyReactiveWebServerFactoryCustomizer, WebSocketJettyServletWebServerFactoryCustomizer, WebSocketTomcatWebServerFactoryCustomizer
Functional Interface:
这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
@FunctionalInterface public interface WebServerFactoryCustomizer<T extends WebServerFactory>
Strategy interface for customizing web server factories. Any beans of this type will get a callback with the server factory before the server itself is started, so you can set the port, address, error pages etc.

注意：对此接口的调用通常由 WebServerFactoryCustomizerBeanPostProcessor 发起，它是一个 BeanPostProcessor（因此在 ApplicationContext 生命周期中非常早期被调用）。在包围的 BeanFactory 中延迟查找依赖项可能比使用 `@Autowired` 注入它们更安全。

Since:
2.0.0
Author:
Phillip Webb，Dave Syer，Brian Clozel
